instruction: Access United's website and open the page for car rental bookings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to navigate from United Airlines homepage to the car rental booking page. Uses existing evaluator functions (is_expected_url_pattern_match metric + active_tab_info getter) to verify the active tab URL matches the expected car rental page pattern. Comparable difficulty to original baggage fee navigation task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter (active_tab_info) extracts the correct state: active tab URL via accessibility tree and Playwright
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) uses appropriate regex pattern matching to verify URL contains expected pattern
Expected value 'united.com/en/us/book/cars' is semantically correct for United Airlines car rental booking page
Complete coverage: single-step navigation task fully verified by checking active tab URL
No postconfig needed: task only requires navigating to a page, getter reads current state correctly
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL → metric compares against pattern → returns pass/fail
